purpose: Non-admission discovery of an original official US administrative boundary release for county-equivalents including Louisiana parishes; no insurer exposure, hazard or model use is admitted.

entries.name: US Census TIGER/Line 2026 county and parish-equivalent administrative boundaries
entries.provider: United States Census Bureau, Geography Division
entries.spatial_scope: United States, Puerto Rico and US island areas covered by Census county and equivalent layers; Louisiana parishes are county-equivalent administrative units
entries.temporal_scope: Boundaries and names as of 2026-01-01, released 2026-10-14; historical catastrophe years require time-specific source versions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: National county-and-equivalent polygon Shapefile ZIP, Census GEOID / state and county FIPS; original ZIP advertised at roughly 80 MB
entries.note: Official public 2026 national COUNTY directory lists tl_2026_us_county.zip at https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2026/COUNTY/ . This catalogue verification is not a downloaded, SHA-256-verified archive, a polygon validation, a model-ready boundary or an insured property portfolio. Preserve GEOID/STATEFP/COUNTYFP, boundary as-of date, exact original ZIP/hash/CRS and source usage terms. Do not join by county/parish name alone or silently carry 2026 boundaries into historical disaster losses. County-equivalent terms differ by jurisdiction, and these geometries contain no catastrophe hazard, asset values, insurance terms or claim data.
